title: Warehouse Transfer Checklist
subtitle: Warehouse Transfer: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Warehouse Transfer Checklist covers inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting. The inventory transfer coordinator records Warehouse Transfer criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Warehouse Transfer Checklist keeps Warehouse Transfer exceptions visible until the inventory transfer coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Warehouse Transfer Checklist at source warehouse, staging lane, vehicle or conveyance, and destination warehouse. Document inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting identity before Warehouse Transfer begins. Compare inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting findings with stated Warehouse Transfer criteria; route unresolved Warehouse Transfer issues to warehouse control reviewer.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Warehouse Transfer, identify responsible parties, source warehouse, staging lane, vehicle or conveyance, and destination warehouse, and the linked inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting source.

fields.label: Item, lot, serial, quantity, and unit of measure
Source, destination, handling-unit, and seal identifiers

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Warehouse Transfer facts for inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Warehouse Transfer finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Inventory Transfer Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Wrong item, lot, serial, or destination
blocks.guidance: Pause Warehouse Transfer when physical quantity, identity, custody, destination receipt, or system posting remains unresolved. Retain the available Warehouse Transfer proof and route unresolved inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting scope to inventory transfer coordinator.
